article.headline: ‘A Court of Thorns and Roses’ Books 6 and 7 Titles and Covers Revealed by Fantasy Author Sarah J Maas
article.summary: The titles for the sixth and seventh “A Court of Thorns and Roses” books have been revealed by author Sarah J. Maas. “ACOTAR” Book 6, coming Oct. 27, is titled “A Court of Splintered Harmony.” Book 7, which will be published Jan. 12, 2027, has been named “A Court of Forgotten Melody.” See Maas’ announcement […]
